description: This script performs post-installation tasks for a software project, specifically for restoring bundled extension runtime dependencies and managing plugin installations. It includes functions for discovering runtime dependencies, creating environment variables for npm installs, and conditionally running post-install steps based on project structure and environment variables.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file at the specified path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a dependency's package.json within node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Collects runtime dependencies and optional dependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies for bundled plugins by scanning the extensions directory.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates environment variables for nested npm installs by removing global config variables.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Checks whether the current directory is the source checkout root based on presence of certain files/directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Determines whether to run the post-install process based on environment and project structure.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Performs the post-installation process, including installing missing dependencies for bundled plugins.
